title: Digital Ange: Dennou Tenshi SS
native_title: デジタル・アンジュ ～電脳天使ＳＳ～
overview: Digital Ange: Dennou Tenshi SS is a remake of Dennou Tenshi: Digital Ange. The story and gameplay are almost identical to the original release, with some minor story additions and higher-quality redrawn artwork. The most significant changes are that the characters have all been redesigned by a different illustrator in a new art style, and all the voice acting has been re-recorded with a different cast.
